pages.title: Laser Cutter
pages.text: A focused beam that cuts copper, silicon and diamond to a micron.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Cuts copper into waveguides, Bitter plates and armatures, silicon and gold into Hall bar chips, and lonsdaleite into plasma thruster nozzles.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bitter Plate, Hall Bar Chip, Plasma Thruster Nozzle, Rail Armature, Waveguide.
